title: Bulk Email Verifier Input
description: Give the Actor addresses in whichever form you already have them: a single address, a pasted list, a link to a CSV or TXT file, or the ID of an existing Apify dataset. You can combine sources — everything is merged and de-duplicated before verification.

emails.title: Email addresses
emails.description: Paste or type the addresses to verify. Duplicates are removed automatically, and lists longer than 1,000 are split into batches for you.

email.title: Single email address
email.description: Verify just one address. Handy for testing, or for calling the Actor once per record from an automation.

emailFileUrl.title: Link to a CSV or TXT file
emailFileUrl.description: A public link to a .csv or .txt file containing your list — a Google Sheets CSV export, an S3 object, a Dropbox direct link. Every address in the file is picked up regardless of which column it sits in, so you can upload your export untouched. Maximum 10 MB.

datasetId.title: Apify dataset ID
datasetId.description: Verify the addresses inside a dataset produced by another Actor — chain this straight onto a scraper without exporting anything in between.
datasetId.sectionCaption: Verify the output of another Actor
datasetId.sectionDescription: Point this Actor at a dataset another run has already produced.

datasetField.title: Field holding the address
datasetField.description: Which field in each dataset record contains the email address, for example "email" or "contactEmail". Leave this empty and every text field on the record is scanned instead.
